name: Cursed Hollow
theme: Collect Tributes to curse the enemy team's structures and minions.

mechanic.title: The Tribute Curse
mechanic.description: Tributes spawn periodically across 6 set locations (first warning at 2:30, spawns at 3:00; 6-second channel). Collecting 3 Tributes curses the enemy team for 70 seconds: all enemy lane minions are reduced to 1 HP, and enemy Towers, Forts, and Keeps stop firing.

camps.name: Siege Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located top-left and bottom-right. Long-range siege damage; easy to solo or duo early.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located near top-mid and bot-mid. Pushes middle lane and provides spell armor aura.

camps.name: Boss / Grave Golem (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located top-right and bottom-left. High-threat late-game win condition, especially during a Curse.

strategy: Global mobility (Falstad, Brightwing, Dehaka) excels on Cursed Hollow due to its large three-lane layout. Remember the 3-Tribute set rule: the first Tribute always spawns in the middle column, never repeats the exact previous spot, and never spawns 3 times in a row on the same half of the map. If you are behind in talent tiers on the first or second Tribute, consider trading soak and camps instead of forcing a bad fight.
